caption: The drawing features three views of a single object, centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The uppermost view shows a circular ring with a decorative border rendered in yellow and white, with a grey-blue gemstone or center piece. Below it to the left, there is a black outline of the object seen from the bottom, displaying a simple circular shape intersected by a horizontal band. To the right of this, another outlined side view depicts a straight shaft widening into a circular end, with detailing on the wider part. There are a few small, faint reddish and brownish stains dispersed near the edges of the paper, with more concentration in the upper corners and at the bottom left. The lower right corner contains a small handwritten inscription.
title: Ring
